homePage.heroHeadline: Get back to what moves you.
homePage.heroSubhead: Care with Dr. Jenn Hartmann for active people navigating recurring pain, stalled recovery, or movement limitations. We connect the relevant pieces and build a practical plan around your goals.

recognitionCards: The pain settles, then comes back.
Recovery has stalled despite trying several approaches.

You feel capable, but not quite like yourself.
homePage.reframeHeading: Understand what matters. Build from there.

children.text: Your history, movement, and everyday demands help put symptoms in context. Dr. Jenn considers the painful area alongside relevant tissue, load, and recovery factors, then explains the priorities in plain language. Your plan may include hands-on care, movement work, or another clinical opinion. The starting point is an assessment of you, with space for questions and decisions together.

children.text: Dr. Jenn brings sports chiropractic, manual therapy, movement, and functional health into one clinical conversation. She starts by listening, then looks for the information that helps decide what to do next. Her love of sport began at five and still shapes her interest in helping people return to the activities they care about. She is especially invested in young athletes pursuing their goals. When a different specialist is the better fit, collaboration and referral are part of the plan.
